title: Page layouts built from sections
problem: Home, product and category pages had one fixed design; the shop could not add a flash sale, brands or reviews to its home page.
now: Layouts for seven page kinds are built from fifteen sections, for all pages or one category, product or page, with draft, preview, publish and undo.
steps: Open Online Store › Layouts and open Home
Add a Video section (paste a YouTube link in its settings) and a FAQ (it starts with two questions), move the countdown up and hide the blog
Watch the preview on Computer and Phone
Press Publish and open the store's home page
